text:
Ivy L.: quick PR heads-up: I'm updating the model-catalog entry for the new quantized family and adding a tiny migration guide + compatibility table. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5250
Marcus T.: nice. can you include an explicit column for instance/precision (e.g., a100-40gb / q8, a100-80gb / fp16) in the perf table so customers can reproduce?
Ivy L.: yup adding that and linking the raw CSV. also adding a one-liner: max sequence 4096, recommended batch <=16.
Sana P.: small nit: the SDK snippet currently uses `client.generate()` which CI will flag. I'll push a micro-commit to switch to `client.text.generate()` and add SNIPPET markers.
Ivy L.: thanks — pls also include a short migration example showing pinning with `@` and an example CLI change.
Marcus T.: wording suggestion for compatibility row: "Quantized variants prioritize throughput; streaming and function-calls may be limited or behave differently. Pin model variant to guarantee behavior."
bench-bot: bench upload: aether-7b-q8 - a100-40gb - runs [1,8,16] - median p95: 36ms, 61ms, 78ms. CSV: s3://bench-uploads/5250/aether7b_q8.csv
Ivy L.: adding a compatibility table row: quantized variant | Streaming: limited | Function-calls: partial | Long-context KV: experimental. Keeping language conservative.
Sana P.: adding migration snippet under "Migration":

```
# old (un-pinned)
resp = client.generate(model="aether-7b-q8", input=prompt)

# new (pin the variant explicitly)
resp = client.text.generate(model="aether-7b@q8-2026-06-01", input=prompt, max_tokens=512)
```

Sana P.: and CLI example: `ri api text --model aether-7b-q8 --prompt "hi"` -> `ri text generate --model aether-7b@q8-2026-06-01 --input "hi"`. Added SNIPPET_START/END markers for py/node/cli.
docs-bot: linkcheck: /model-catalog/aether-7b -> 404 (branch: ivy/quantized-catalog)
Ivy L.: ah I moved the card when reorganizing folders, fixing links now.
ci-bot: docs build failed - missing snippet marker `SNIPPET_START:sdk-py-q` in model-card/aether-7b.md
Sana P.: pushed the missing marker and tiny Python/Node examples. Python uses `client.text.generate(...)`, Node uses `client.text.generate(...)`. Kept outputs minimal.
bench-bot: updated CSV after final run: s3://bench-uploads/5250/aether7b_q8_v2.csv (same median p95 numbers).
Marcus T.: small wording tweak on the compatibility note to emphasize pinning; pushed a grammar fix.
Ivy L.: preview deployed: https://deploy-preview--docs.redwood.ai/model-catalog/aether-7b (branch: ivy/quantized-catalog)
docs-bot: preview shows one internal absolute link to /sdk/migration -> should be relative.
Ivy L.: fixing link to ../sdk/migration and re-pushing.
ci-bot: build passed (job #2721) on branch ivy/quantized-catalog
Marcus T.: approved, merging once bench CSV is attached to the PR.
bench-bot: attached final CSV to PR.
Ivy L.: merged and backported small snippet markers to stable branch. Thanks all for quick help. Closing thread. :tada:
